timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I know I need a boundary, and I feel uncomfortable.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I am worried they will be disappointed in me.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Part of me wants to say yes just to avoid tension.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep rehearsing every possible reaction.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is bracing for conflict.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I feel guilty for having limits.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am afraid this boundary will change the relationship.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that saying no feels vulnerable.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I am carrying their reaction before it has happened.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can tolerate the discomfort of being clear.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: A boundary is information about what I can offer.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I do not need a dramatic explanation.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: Their feelings can exist without deciding my answer.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften while I hold my limit.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: Guilt does not always mean I am doing something wrong.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can be kind without saying yes.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: A healthy relationship can make room for honesty.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can release responsibility for managing the response.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am ready to communicate my boundary clearly.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can use simple and respectful words.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to stay connected to what I need.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can listen without negotiating against myself.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel calm and firm.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am allowed to protect my capacity.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can repeat my answer if clarity is needed.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can let honesty support this relationship.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to say what is true for me.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
